description: Decisions of the state of a diagnostic recording on the answers of its recorder and of the filesystem (docs/spec/host-contract.md, the cases `recording.*`), replayed by the Go and Rust host tests. The recorder gives the answers (open, start, stop) and the filesystem gives the removal result of the owned folder; each decision is a function of those answers, so a case lists the answers as data and the text that the host reports. `directory` is the folder that a recording or its cleanup owns, empty for none. `stopped` is whether the native recording has ended. A null `cause` is no error before the removal, and a null `removal` is a removal that succeeded. The recorder is judged against the real window server by e2e/capture-state.test.mjs, and the real filesystem refusal of a removal by the host tests of each language.
